'''Tunyok''' was a frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Gamorr system/Legends|Opoku system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
While the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was underway, orbital scans were indicating that the prehistoric ice layers contained so far undiscovered isotopes.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Core Composition}}</ref>
